integrity: Proof is elementary after invoking standard prime distribution theorems. Exact-arithmetic reproducibility checks are supportive, not a substitute for the proof. No independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient conditions and parameter-density theorem only, not a classification of all prime-shift parameters or all reciprocal-divisibility solutions. Classical conic dynamics are an antecedent; historical implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Density-one infinite positive orbits in a reciprocal quadratic divisibility family
